content: When autoclass_content='both', get_doc returns [class_doc_lines, __init__doc_lines]. Old _find_signature matches __init__ from docstrings[1]. New loop: line_idx=0, while line_idx<len(doclines): first line likely '' because docstring starts with newline; py_ext_sig_re.match('') returns None, loop breaks immediately, misses signature. Original also had doclines[0]='' and continued, but only iterated docstrings[0] then failed on __init__ similarly; unclear why original test passed — need to inspect test lines more carefully.
